Name: A Date with Death Grim as Krobus
Author: NagiisangBibe
Description:
I wanted a hot Krobus mod that fit my taste, so I turned Krobus into "Grim" from A Date with Death. The portraits I made are based on Grim's portraits in ADWD.

You can also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38421]turn Krobus' room into Grim's room[/url].

Known Bugs:[list]
[*]Grim's overworld sprite is cut in half in some scenarios, such as during a Winter Mystery. This extends to some SVE scenarios that use Krobus' sprites. Assume this is the same for other expansion mods.
[/list]
I'm just one person and a humble uni student. I also have little knowledge about programming and modding, and this is my very first mod, which I followed a tutorial to do. I have a to-do list for things I want to add to this mod, but they will take time.

[center][color=#e06666]﻿[/color][/center][b][color=#ea9999][size=4][center]Call for Collaborators[/center][/size][/color][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=2]A few people have expressed interest in a whole new Grim NPC. I'm considering it, and it would be easier for me if I had collaborators, such as writers or programmers. I can handle the art, but if you're interested in collaborating with me as an artist, feel free to reach out. I'm gonna say upfront that collaborating with me will be purely voluntary, as I won't be making any money from my mods (as far as I know). If you're interested, feel free to send me a message or comment on this mod. I might start working on this next summer break (summer 2026) as I expect to be busy with uni. Thank you![/size][color=#ea9999][size=2]
